name: raven-verifier
description: VSCode integration of the Raven language and verifier.

ravenServer.maxNumberOfProblems.description: Controls the maximum number of problems produced by the server.

ravenServer.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the language server.

ravenServer.executablePath.description: Path to the Raven executable. Leave empty to let the extension choose one; set this to point at a different build (e.g. a local dev build) instead. Overrides the update channel.

enumDescriptions: Use the latest released Raven verifier, downloading it when one appears.
Use the specific Raven release named by 'ravenServer.ravenVersion'.
Use only the verifier bundled with this extension, and never download one.
ravenServer.updateChannel.description: Which Raven verifier to run. The extension always ships a working verifier; on the 'stable' channel it can also install newer ones as they are released, so a new Raven release does not have to wait for a new extension release.

ravenServer.ravenVersion.description: The Raven release tag to use (e.g. 'v1.2.0') when 'ravenServer.updateChannel' is 'tag'. Ignored otherwise.

ravenServer.checkForUpdates.description: Check once a day whether a newer Raven verifier has been released, and offer to install it. Nothing is downloaded without asking. Use the 'Raven: Update Verifier' command to check on demand.

ravenServer.showGutterIcons.description: Mark lines carrying a diagnostic with an icon in the editor's gutter: an error icon for failures, an information icon for related locations. Hovering an icon shows the messages on that line. Requires the glyph margin to be visible ('editor.glyphMargin').

ravenServer.highlightRelatedLocations.description: Underline a diagnostic's related locations in the editor (in the Information colour, rather than the error's red) when they fall in the file being edited. They remain listed under the diagnostic in the Problems panel either way.

scripts.postinstall: cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && cd ..
